question: Which of the following 0.1 M aqueous solutions has the highest boiling point? (Assume complete dissociation)
solution: ΔT<sub>b</sub> = i · K<sub>b</sub> · m. Al<sub>2</sub>(SO<sub>4</sub>)<sub>3</sub> gives the maximum ions (i = 5), so it has the highest boiling point.

question: State Kohlrausch's law of independent migration of ions. Write one application.
solution:
Limiting molar conductivity of an electrolyte is the sum of individual contributions of its cation and anion (Λ°m = ν+λ°+ + ν−λ°−).
Application: Calculating Λ°m of weak electrolytes like CH3COOH.
